{{Top|leg}}
An '''ancient [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple''']] was believed to have existed in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] as of circa [[517 BBY]].

At that point, many of the fishing [[222 fishing trawler|trawlers]] that made most of the economy of the then-young [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]] suddenly disappeared in the open [[Ocean/Legends|sea]], without any loss of [[transponder]]. As the situation was unexplained, some citizens of Bartyn's Landing rumored that the sailors had discovered this Sith temple and that a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] had captured the trawlers in a scheme to use it for an assault on their city. The real reason was [[Sailor's Union|much more mundane]].
